### 2026-10-30: So i was recording lapse and again it glitched out sometime i dont know how , mostly i have a bad internet conection that's why i worked for 1hr 30mins almost and it's showing 54 minutes recorded so i

**0.5h**

So i was recording lapse and again it glitched out sometime i dont know how , mostly i have a bad internet conection that's why i worked for 1hr 30mins almost and it's showing 54 minutes recorded so i am writing this journal for timelapse of WEEK 4 day 5 part 1 .

Here i am trying to upgrade my deskbuddy with RTC and will add a esp32 in the PCB with RCT and oled connections and some touches sensor and a buzzer for making it a time clock buddy too if needed
I am separating it to 2 esp32 so their is no lag or MENU problem in oled which we would have faced and it will run BT speaker and time clock independently
Mostly i do timelapses but this glitch comes so i did the 30mins journal.

### 2026-10-30: HI so again the system crashed some how but this time i think i lost like 30 minutes

**1.73h**

HI so again the system crashed some how but this time i think i lost like 30 minutes
here is the screenshot :

![Screenshot 2026-10-30 222310](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/fEl27nUId85bdpY1FRjmh6N1ebYpyxYm/6e6cc7ee1da75cbddbdfb3eb4734a7760d31ab56317276f3d8b26689574f77e6.png)

It was in a timelapse i am recording right now , So i thought to journal it .
In this session i finally coded the whole system
with alarm working buzzer playing when alarm hits
and timelapse glitch is also fixed.
I faced some problems such as when i used millis() , it was not resetting thought i need to write in guide that User needs to click the reset button to refresh the whole thing but found it how to make it working by putting a flag in the second checker system where it checks and makes the previous entries false and by using millis() - starttime , i did it yayay
IN alarm system once of the issues i faced that was when alarm is off it is again bouncing back to alarm system so i put a flag that checks alarm is over or not and globally i set it to true and when alarm gets off it goes false .so i added it in the alarm system that if(alarmst == false){break;} and it worked and one of the major is issues was solved .
IT really feels great to code from scratch without even using one line of AI.
LOL...
In next i will update my PCB so it can support the oled and another ESP32 and a buzzer .

### 2026-10-31: Hi in this session i made those changes in my schematic like i added the DS3231 sensor and learnt about it that it dosn't require 5V and  can work with 3.3V logic output of esp32 . I got to know that

**2.12h**

Hi in this session i made those changes in my schematic like i added the DS3231 sensor and learnt about it that it dosn't require 5V and  can work with 3.3V logic output of esp32 . I got to know that we can just use those 4 pins of that sensor and work with it. I opened up my simulator and then placed all the components and ports as it was in simulation as i did , then i removed the ground planes in the previous PCB , reshaped the board outline and placed all the components inside it and started routing the board , it almost took me more than 2hrs but somehow again my lapse glitched due to network issue and it shows 36 minutes.
So i thought i will journal my entry , SIlkscreen part is still left and labelling the ports in PCB except that everything is ready in Pixelated buddy In next session will do silk screen and start making a enclosure for my buddy.
